title: TPWD Wildlife Project Review

source_citations.reference: Environmental Review Team Project Review Requests

explanations.trigger_explanation: Projects that overlap sensitive wildlife resources or Texas Parks and Wildlife Department-managed lands commonly receive a project review request to identify avoidance, minimization, and mitigation recommendations.

known_unknowns: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department environmental review is coordination-based, and a mandatory submission pathway depends on the lead permit, funding source, land ownership, or another agency process.
advisories: Additional review recommended whenever rare species, significant habitats, or Texas Parks and Wildlife Department-managed lands may be affected.
notes: Confidence tier 3 because official Texas Parks and Wildlife Department materials clearly support the review process, but project-specific mandatory pathways are variable and should be confirmed.
